verdict.rationale: Make documents a first-party 'Make AI Agents app' for agentic automation, and AI Agents API endpoints in open beta, so agent steps appear to be a native capability. The evidence never shows the agent placed as a step inside a scenario, or any model selection or tool-use configuration. The MCP server evidence covers the reverse direction (external AIs calling scenarios), so it does not count toward this story. Missing for 10: documented LLM/agent module usage inside scenarios, model choice, tool use by in-workflow agents, independent corroboration, and a non-beta status.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI agent or LLM steps inside a workflow, with model choice and tool use

citations.quote: learn about agentic automation with the make ai agents app
